title: loan_application.submitted (LOS)
description: One event = one row of application_train.csv, application_test.csv (original column names and values are kept in payload). event_time: Submission time: random week (fixed seed) on the application's own WEEKDAY_APPR_PROCESS_START and HOUR_APPR_PROCESS_START.

event_id.description: BLAKE2b-128 of source_table + natural key. Deterministic -> use it for de-duplication.

schema_version.description: SemVer. A MAJOR change -> new topic (.v2).

event_time.description: Business time (simulated, +07:00). Submission time: random week (fixed seed) on the application's own WEEKDAY_APPR_PROCESS_START and HOUR_APPR_PROCESS_START.

produced_at.description: Wall-clock time the producer sent the event.

customer_id.description: SK_ID_CURR of the customer; also the Kafka message key.

SK_ID_CURR.description: ID of loan in our sample

NAME_CONTRACT_TYPE.description: Identification if loan is cash or revolving

FLAG_OWN_CAR.description: Flag if the client owns a car

FLAG_OWN_REALTY.description: Flag if client owns a house or flat

CNT_CHILDREN.description: Number of children the client has

AMT_GOODS_PRICE.description: For consumer loans it is the price of the goods for which the loan is given

NAME_TYPE_SUITE.description: Who was accompanying client when he was applying for the loan

NAME_INCOME_TYPE.description: Clients income type (businessman, working, maternity leave,…)

NAME_EDUCATION_TYPE.description: Level of highest education the client achieved

NAME_HOUSING_TYPE.description: What is the housing situation of the client (renting, living with parents, ...)

REGION_POPULATION_RELATIVE.description: Normalized population of region where client lives (higher number means the client lives in more populated region)

DAYS_BIRTH.description: Client's age in days at the time of application
DAYS_BIRTH.x-note: time only relative to the application

DAYS_EMPLOYED.description: How many days before the application the person started current employment
DAYS_EMPLOYED.x-note: time only relative to the application

DAYS_REGISTRATION.description: How many days before the application did client change his registration
DAYS_REGISTRATION.x-note: time only relative to the application

DAYS_ID_PUBLISH.description: How many days before the application did client change the identity document with which he applied for the loan
DAYS_ID_PUBLISH.x-note: time only relative to the application

OCCUPATION_TYPE.description: What kind of occupation does the client have

CNT_FAM_MEMBERS.description: How many family members does client have

REGION_RATING_CLIENT.description: Our rating of the region where client lives (1,2,3)

REGION_RATING_CLIENT_W_CITY.description: Our rating of the region where client lives with taking city into account (1,2,3)

WEEKDAY_APPR_PROCESS_START.description: On which day of the week did the client apply for the loan

HOUR_APPR_PROCESS_START.description: Approximately at what hour did the client apply for the loan

REG_REGION_NOT_LIVE_REGION.description: Flag if client's permanent address does not match contact address (1=different, 0=same, at region level)

REG_REGION_NOT_WORK_REGION.description: Flag if client's permanent address does not match work address (1=different, 0=same, at region level)

LIVE_REGION_NOT_WORK_REGION.description: Flag if client's contact address does not match work address (1=different, 0=same, at region level)

REG_CITY_NOT_LIVE_CITY.description: Flag if client's permanent address does not match contact address (1=different, 0=same, at city level)

REG_CITY_NOT_WORK_CITY.description: Flag if client's permanent address does not match work address (1=different, 0=same, at city level)

LIVE_CITY_NOT_WORK_CITY.description: Flag if client's contact address does not match work address (1=different, 0=same, at city level)

ORGANIZATION_TYPE.description: Type of organization where client works

EXT_SOURCE_1.description: Normalized score from external data source

EXT_SOURCE_2.description: Normalized score from external data source

EXT_SOURCE_3.description: Normalized score from external data source
